# `.github/` — GitHub-Specific Configuration

This directory contains GitHub-specific files: issue templates, pull request templates, and (when added) workflow definitions.

---

## Files

- `ISSUE_TEMPLATE.md` — template for new issues.
- `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` — template for new pull requests.

---

## Future Additions (Once Implementation Begins)

- `workflows/ci.yml` — continuous integration (lint, format, type-check, tests).
- `workflows/release.yml` — release automation (PyPI publish, GitHub release).
- `workflows/eval.yml` — nightly eval harness runs.
- `FUNDING.yml` — sponsorship configuration if applicable.
- `SECURITY.md` — vulnerability reporting process.

These are added as the project moves through roadmap phases.
